content.text:
URBO_INSTANCE=workspace
URBO_PROXY_PORT=80
=== spring-app service block ===
  spring-app:
    build:
      context: ../.
      dockerfile: docker/spring/Dockerfile
      secrets:
        - github_token
    restart: unless-stopped
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8081; echo -e 'GET /health HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n' >&3"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 30
      start_period: 60s
    depends_on:
      urbo-backend-postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      keycloak:
        condition: service_healthy
      localstack:
        condition: service_healthy
      sendinblue-api:
        condition: service_healthy
    entrypoint: ["java", "-Dspring.profiles.active=local", "-jar", "/app.jar"]
    networks:
      default:
        aliases:
          - spring-app.${URBO_INSTANCE}.internal
    labels:
      io.swcode.urbo.instance: ${URBO_INSTANCE}

observation.command: cd /workspace && cat .urbo/workspace/env | grep -E "URBO_PROXY_PORT|URBO_INSTANCE" ; echo "=== spring-app service block ==="; sed -n '168,196p' backend/docker/docker-compose.yml
